guynmart_drunkard5_100.m: Let's have a sip, then I will tell you my story.
r: I think I had better keep the bottles in my bag.

guynmart_drunkard5_102.m:
[Fjoerkard empties a bottle]
Oh yes, I remember it well ... It was a dark and stormy night up in the mountains.

guynmart_drunkard5_110.m: My men and I had been on the road for hours, without a break and without the slightest sign of getting closer to our goal.

guynmart_drunkard5_12.m: I think you have forgotten something...?
r: Oh, yes, of course, I will get some bottles of wine.

guynmart_drunkard5_120.m: We silently trudged one by one up the tortuous path that led up the steep slope, always wary of the treacherous shadows of the bushes on either side, and always listening for signs of danger.

guynmart_drunkard5_13.m: Hey, get us some bottles of wine! I could tell you things you wouldn't believe!
r: Good idea! I'll go for the wine, wait a minute.

guynmart_drunkard5_130.m: You don't mind if I open another bottle?

guynmart_drunkard5_132.m:
[Fjoerkard empties the bottle]
Gornauds were said to be roaming in those mountains. We had not seen any, by the shadow, but we had already crossed their traces several times.
And there were rumors about even more dangerous creatures - I will not even name them.

guynmart_drunkard5_14.m: Oh. The wine bottles are all empty. Could you get some more?
r: Yes, of course. I will get some more bottles.

guynmart_drunkard5_140.m: A lonely hut came into sight. A friendly light in the midst of the wilderness. There we would ask to camp for the night. New strength flowed through us, when suddenly all hell broke loose.

guynmart_drunkard5_150.m: Gornauds jumped out from behind the rocks, so close that we could clearly see their facial features. For a few terrible seconds I thought that those would be our last seconds.

guynmart_drunkard5_162.m:
[Another bottle]
But then we realized that the monsters were after an easier prey. A small figure was in front of us on the path. A child? Alone up there?

guynmart_drunkard5_170.m: Shaken, I closed my eyes, despite the great danger. I did not want to look at the slaughter. The dreadful noise lasted only a few seconds.

guynmart_drunkard5_180.m: The ground was soaked with red blood. But - it came from the gornauds! The child just wiped the weapon clean of blood, gave us a quick glance, and disappeared up the path.

guynmart_drunkard5_192.m:
[Another bottle]
We had had enough of that cursed march. Panicked, we ran back down the path. Tired as we were, we ran without stopping even once, to the inn in the valley, from which we had departed in the morning.

guynmart_drunkard5_20.m: You standing over me makes me feel uncomfortable. Take a seat next to me first.

guynmart_drunkard5_200.m: Never will I forget that useless journey. Often I see it again in a nightmare and then I seek the memory of a friendly inn. Where once there was a little girl, probably the daughter of the landlord.

guynmart_drunkard5_212.m:
[Yet another bottle]
She got some wine for an old bearded guest and asked for a tale, and he began: Oh yes, I remember it well ... It was a dark and stormy night up in the mountains.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
